- Taking ownership of processing supplier invoices from start to finish, making sure each one is matched, coded correctly and backed up by the right paperwork.

- Someone who takes real pride in their work. You'll be handling a high volume of invoices and payments, so accuracy really matters and we need someone diligent who naturally double checks their work.
- A confident Excel user who's comfortable working in spreadsheets every day and keen to sharpen those skills even further.
- Someone who genuinely loves to learn and sees training as an opportunity rather than a box to tick.
- A clear, friendly communicator who's happy picking up the phone to chase a payment or sort out a query.
- Someone organised enough to juggle deadlines across both payables and receivables without dropping the ball.
- Ambition to build a long-term career in finance, whether you're already studying towards a qualification or thinking about starting one.

- A salary of up to £28,000, depending on experience.

- Structured on-site training from a team who genuinely want to see you succeed.

description:
A respected and family-focused organisation is seeking an experienced Part-Time Payroll Clerk to become part of its expanding finance function. This position offers a welcoming and supportive workplace, hybrid working options, and flexible hours to help maintain a healthy work-life balance. It would suit an individual seeking a stable, long-term opportunity with flexibility around their working pattern. There may also be the possibility of increasing the hours to full-time in the future for the right candidate.

In this role, you will take responsibility for the accurate and timely administration of payroll, covering both salaried and hourly-paid employees within a fast-paced finance setting. Responsibilities will include processing payroll and timesheets, verifying payroll information, keeping employee records up to date, responding to payroll-related queries, carrying out payroll reconciliations, and assisting with pension journals and financial account reconciliations. You will need to be comfortable working autonomously, have a high level of accuracy, and possess the ability to investigate and correct discrepancies while helping to enhance existing finance procedures.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience in a payroll-focused role, with the ability to process both hourly and salaried payroll accurately in a busy finance environment
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, with experience handling, reviewing and analysing payroll figures, timesheets and other financial data
- A meticulous approach to your work, combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to complete payroll and account reconciliations accurately
- Excellent communication and time-management skills, with the ability to organise workloads, prioritise effectively and consistently meet deadlines

In return, you will receive:
- Hybrid working arrangements and flexible hours to help maintain a strong work-life balance, with the possibility of moving into a full-time position in the future if preferred
- Regular reviews of salary alongside training and development opportunities designed to recognise your contribution and encourage continued career growth
- A friendly and supportive, family-led team environment with comprehensive training and ongoing support
- The chance to work for an established and successful organisation offering stability, onsite parking, flexibility and genuine scope for long-term career progression

If you are an experienced Part-Time Payroll Clerk seeking a flexible position within a friendly and supportive organisation, this could be an excellent opportunity to take the next step in your career. Apply now to avoid missing out!

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Purchase Ledger Clerk required for a new permanent opportunity working for a well established business based at Birmingham Business Park, Solihull, with a view to start immediately. You will be working as part of a long standing purchase ledger team and be responsible for the day to day running of the purchase ledger function. Your duties will include matching batching and coding invoices, reconciling supplier statements, processing payments, resolving queries, processing employee expenses and assisting with month end. You will also be required to work with foreign currency payments and assist with bank reconciliations.

My client is looking for an experienced purchase ledger clerk who can join the team and make a positive contribution. This is an office based role so will suit someone from the local area; my client is offering a pleasant working environment, on site parking and an early finish on Friday so apply now!
